description:

Quick, which decade gave us Street Fighter, Mortal Kombat and
Super Mario movies? If you said the 90s, you’re right! If you said
the 2020’s... You’re also right! Time is an infinite loop.

The original Street Fighter movie was only the second video game
to ever be adapted into a movie. Needless to say, they didn’t
quite know what they were doing just yet.
